name: Denver
living: the alpenglow on the snow-capped peaks slowly fades from pink to lavender over the session
a thin wisp of snow blows off the highest summit (slow sprite drift)
downtown tower windows flicker on one by one as dusk deepens
the video boards' pixel graphics pulse softly and flash after a home run
the peach pixel clouds drift slowly across the sky
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe, moths drifting through their cones
a red aircraft-warning light blinks slowly on the tallest tower
the purple pennant on the left tower flutters in the thin mountain air
the evergreen trees in the batter's eye sway very slightly
a thin crowd shimmer in the purple seats, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
